text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, July 1 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 1-2 days, bulk vessels 5-6 days, general cargo 4-5 days. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth. 2 Discharging at anchorage, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 Under repairs, 2 awaiting orders.

Calcutta - 31 Vessels due (3 coking coal, 9 product tankers, 9 containers, 2 crude oil, 3 tneb coal, 1 limestone, 1 steel, 1 petcoke, 1 lash barge). 8 Vessels loading at berth, 15 discharging at berth, 2 bunkering.

Cochin - 10 Vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected in port. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Repairs/drydock, 1 general cargo, 2 ferry boats at CSL jetty, 1 tanker at drydock.

Chennai (Madras) - 24 Vessels due of which 6 coal, 2 general, 4 fertiliser, 3 iron ore, 7 containers, 1 quartz, 2 oil. Delays, coal/coke, others 2-3 days, fertiliser, scrap 5-6 days, no delay for iron ore. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 11 discharging at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge.
Mormugao - Four vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Kandla - 14 Vessels due, 10-20 days berthing delay expected. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 13 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 loading in stream, 3 discharging at berth, 1 discharging in stream. 3 Tankers, 12 vessels waiting.
Mangalore - Nine vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected. 3 Vessels loading/discharging at berth, 2 awaiting berth, 1 under repair.

Jawaharlal Nehru - Vessels due, 1 fertiliser, 6 tankers/iron ore. Delays expected, 18-20 days for fertiliser, 1-2 days for tankers. 2 Vessels discharging at berth, 1 iron ore discharging at anchorage, 8 waiting at anchorage to discharge.
Paradip - Five vessels due, up to 1 days berthing delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Tuticorin - Four vessels due, 1-2 days berthing delay at present. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 awaiting orders.

Visakhapatnam - 15 Vessels due, 7-8 days delay expected. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 15 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 12 waiting at anchorage to load at inner hbour berth.
